Each file has: mockup_description (what the image shows), current_implementation (what's real today, with exact file paths), missing_to_add (concrete, scoped gaps with priority/effort).
headline_finding: The mockups describe a considerably larger product than ATTENDANCE-IMPLEMENTATION-PLAN.md scoped or built. Most gaps are additive (new pages/columns on top of what's real). One gap is a direct reversal of a decision made this session: the mockups show a full submit -> lock -> admin-reopen-with-reason register lifecycle, which is exactly the attendanceRegisters/attendanceEntries/attendanceAuditEvents model that was deleted this session as 'zero writers, dead weight'. That call was correct given the evidence available at the time (those tables really were unused), but these mockups are new evidence the feature was actually wanted -- see 05-mobile-register-lifecycle.json before building anything else attendance-related.
